notes: «وَ رُوِيَ» is a passive opening with no named transmitter: an unnamed link.
Muhammad b. Muslim is asked («أنه سئل»); the Imam who answers is not named in the text and no previous report is given, so no Imam is written.
«وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلَيْنِ» is a second question under the same narrator, not a new isnad.
